followerDiff.intro: Compare two exports of your follower list to see who followed, who unfollowed and who doesn't follow back. Instagram shares no follower names through its API, so this works only with files you download from Instagram yourself.

guide.title: How to get the files
guide.s1: On your phone, open Instagram as @{username}, go to your profile and tap the menu (☰), then Accounts Center.
guide.s2: Tap Your information and permissions, then Export your information (older versions: Download your information).
guide.s3: Tap Create export, choose @{username}, then Export to device.
guide.s4: Tap Customize information, clear everything, then tick only Followers and following.
guide.s5: Set Date range to All time and Format to JSON (not HTML), then tap Start export.
guide.s6: Instagram tells you when the file is ready (minutes to a few days). Download the .zip before the link expires and unzip it.
guide.s7: Open the folder connections › followers_and_following and upload followers_1.json (plus followers_2.json and so on, if there are more) and following.json here.
guide.privacy: The files are read on this device. Only usernames and follow dates are sent to in2sight; only you can see them, and they are deleted with the account or when you delete the snapshot.

phase.needs_reconnect: Instagram no longer accepts this connection. Reconnect the account to continue.
phase.stalled: No progress for a while. Try syncing again.

sync.estimating: Estimating… usually 5–10 minutes. You can leave this page; progress is saved.
sync.summary: Imported {days} days of account metrics and {posts} posts.

analysis.coverage: {pct} of this period imported so far

reasons.not_enough_history: Not enough history to compare yet
reasons.not_enough_posts: Needs ~30+ posts for a reliable pattern
reasons.needs_5_viewers: Instagram shares Story insights from 5 viewers

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.bell: Notifications, {count, plural, =0 {none unread} one {# unread} other {# unread}}
notifications.unread: {count, plural, one {# unread notification} other {# unread notifications}}
notifications.emptyHint: Alerts about expiring access, failing syncs, reach drops and posts taking off show up here.

token_expiring.title: Instagram access expiring
token_expiring.body: @{username}: access ends in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Reconnect to keep syncing.

needs_reconnect.title: Reconnect needed
needs_reconnect.body: @{username} lost its Instagram connection. Reconnect it on the Accounts page.

sync_failing.title: Sync failing
sync_failing.body: @{username}: the last {runs, plural, one {# sync} other {# syncs}} failed. Check the Accounts page.

reach_drop.title: Reach dropped
reach_drop.body: @{username}: reach over the last 7 days is down {pct}% vs the 7 days before.

taking_off.title: Post taking off
taking_off.body: A post by @{username} has {ratio}× its usual reach.

moderation_paused.title: Auto-hide paused
moderation_paused.body: Auto-hide for @{username} is paused because Instagram refused to hide a comment. Open Moderation to see why and switch it on again.

setup.title: Almost there
setup.body: in2sight needs its Supabase connection before you can sign in. Add these variables to .env.local (and to Vercel), then reload.

install.label: Install in2sight
install.body: Install in2sight on this device for a full-screen app and push notifications.
install.ios: To install on iPhone or iPad: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Push notifications need this.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: in2sight needs a connection to show your insights. Nothing private is stored on this device.

export.title: Export
export.description: Download an Excel workbook or a PDF report.
export.periodHint: The time range selected on this page (default: last 30 days).
export.reportTitleHint: Up to 120 characters. Empty uses the default title.
export.noteHint: Printed under the title. Up to 1,000 characters.
export.pdfSlow: The first PDF after a quiet spell can take up to half a minute.

errors.bad_params: That export request is not valid. Reopen the dialog and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.not_found: That account or group no longer exists.
errors.pdf_failed: The PDF could not be generated. Try again in a minute.
errors.not_configured: PDF export is not configured on this server (NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL).

export.storiesCapped: Only the newest {n} Stories of this account are listed; older Stories in this range are not included.

item.notFound: This post is not in your connected accounts.
item.followersHint: Follower count from every sync (about every 30 minutes), last value per hour. Instagram reports reach and views only per day, so there is no hourly reach.
item.followersSummary: Follower count per hour from {from} to {to}.
item.followersEmpty: No follower snapshots for these days yet.
item.audienceHint: All {format} reach of @{username} on {day}, split by followers. Instagram does not split a single post's reach.
item.audienceEmpty: No follower breakdown for that day yet.

views.title: Saved views
views.empty: No saved views yet. Save the current settings to come back to them in one click.
views.saveHint: Saves the metrics, grouping, filters and time range. A preset such as “Last 30 days” keeps moving with today; fixed dates stay fixed.
views.name: Name
views.deleteBody: Only the saved view is removed. Your data stays as it is.

errors.invalid_state: This view cannot be saved. Reload the page and try again.
errors.duplicate: A view with this name already exists.
errors.too_many: You can keep up to 50 views. Delete one first.

explorer.title: Explorer
explorer.subtitle: Pick metrics, group them, and click any bar or row to go one level deeper
explorer.accountTotalsHint: Followers, reach, views, interactions, net follows and engagement are daily account totals: they group by group, account or time only and cannot be narrowed to a format, tag, weekday or hour.
explorer.accountsPicked: {count, plural, one {# account picked} other {# accounts picked}}
explorer.publishedHint: Weekday and hour are when each post was published, in your timezone. Instagram reports reach and views only per day, so there is no hourly reach.
explorer.drillHint: Click a bar or a row to go one level deeper.
explorer.chartSummary: {metric} for {count} rows. The table below lists the same rows.
explorer.truncated: Showing the newest {count} posts in this range. Narrow the range to see older ones.
explorer.empty: No data for this selection. Widen the range or remove a filter.
explorer.partial: * The range cuts this period, so it holds fewer days.

timeScope.label: Time range
timeScope.customHint: Days start at midnight in your timezone ({tz}).
timeScope.weekDay: Pick any day of the week
timeScope.partial: Data starts {date}: earlier days in this range have no data.
timeScope.comparePartial: Data starts {date}: the comparison period is incomplete, so some changes can't be shown.
timeScope.compareAllHint: All time has no earlier period to compare with.

postLab.goneHint: Instagram no longer has this post; the numbers are the last ones captured.
postLab.scorecardHint: Against your last {n, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}} of this format published before it.
postLab.fewPeers: Comparisons need 5+ earlier posts of this format that have the number.

reasonHint.unsupported: Instagram doesn't report this number for this format.
reasonHint.not_captured: Extra numbers are collected while a post is under 30 days old (since October 2026); a busy sync can skip them once.
reasonHint.not_measured: Instagram has not shared numbers for this post yet; new posts are measured every hour.
reasonHint.needs_5_viewers: Instagram shares Story insights only from 5 viewers.
reasonHint.no_reach: A rate needs reach, and this post has none yet.
reasonHint.no_followers: There is no follower count for the posting day (counts are kept from the day the account was connected).

why.breakout: Reach is {ratio}× your median of the last {n} posts of this format.
why.rank: Reach is higher than {pct}% of your last {n} posts of this format.
why.tooEarly: Reach keeps growing for about a week: check again after day 7.
why.tooEarlyStory: The Story is still live: its final numbers come when it expires.
why.fewPosts: Needs 5+ earlier posts of this format with reach to compare ({n} so far).

velocity.title: Velocity
velocity.hint: Cumulative, next to the median of your other posts of this format at the same age.
velocity.lead: At {at} this post had {ratio}× the {metric, select, reach {median reach} other {median views}} of {n} comparable posts.
velocity.noLead: Not enough comparable snapshots yet to compare the pace.
velocity.summary: Bar chart of this post's {metric, select, reach {cumulative reach} other {cumulative views}} at each checkpoint next to the median of comparable posts. The table below lists the numbers.

story.funnelHint: Counts and share of this Story's views.
story.noData: Instagram shares Story insights only from 5 viewers.
story.sequenceHint: In posting order: reach compared with the day's first Story, and the share of viewers who left.

caption.title: Caption lab
caption.hint: What this caption contains, and how your posts of this format did with and without each trait.
caption.question: Asks a question
caption.splitCaption: Median reach with and without each caption trait
caption.notCause: A pattern in your own last {n} measured posts of this format, not a cause: topic, time and visuals differ too.
caption.needMore: The comparison needs {min} measured posts of this format; there are {n} so far.

similar.title: Similar posts
similar.hint: Your earlier posts of the same format, those with the same tags first.

postLab.unavailable: The Post Lab needs a database update
